commit.subject: LU-21165 lctl: use int for del_ost getopt result
commit.message:
LU-21165 lctl: use int for del_ost getopt result

Change jt_del_ost() to store the getopt_long() return value in an int
instead of char, preserving the -1 end-of-options sentinel on
platforms where plain char is unsigned.
